ai_changes.impact: The setup.sh script is now production-ready and works across all major Linux distributions. When run with sudo, it automatically creates systemd service files that enable SIEMply to run as a system service with automatic startup on boot, proper logging, and automatic restart on failure. The script intelligently detects the operating system and uses the appropriate package manager (apt for Debian/Ubuntu, dnf/yum for RHEL/CentOS/Fedora/Rocky/AlmaLinux). Services can be managed using standard systemctl commands, and logs are available both through journalctl and file-based logging in the logs/ directory. This makes SIEMply suitable for production deployments on any major Linux distribution.
